schema_prompt_context:
### TABEL: a1_company_list
**Columns:**
  - company_list_id (uuid, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: gen_random_uuid())
  - job_number (text, NOT NULL)
  - name (text, NOT NULL)
  - company_name (text, NOT NULL)
  - created_by (text, NOT NULL)
  - customer_code (character varying, NULLABLE)
**Foreign Keys:** (None)

### TABEL: a2_conversation_files
**Columns:**
  - id (uuid, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: gen_random_uuid())
  - conversation_id (uuid, NOT NULL)
  - file_name (text, NOT NULL)
  - file_type (character varying, NOT NULL)
  - file_url (text, NOT NULL)
  - file_size_kb (integer, NULLABLE)
  - uploaded_by (uuid, NOT NULL)
  - uploaded_at (timestamp with time zone, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: now())
**Foreign Keys:**
  * FK: conversation_id -> a2_record_conversations(id)
  * FK: uploaded_by -> d3_employee(id)

### TABEL: a2_record_conversations
**Columns:**
  - id (uuid, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: gen_random_uuid())
  - job_number (character varying, NULLABLE)
  - customer_id (uuid, NOT NULL)
  - customer_code (character varying, NULLABLE)
  - sales_pic_id (uuid, NOT NULL)
  - channel_type (character varying, NOT NULL)
  - conversation_date (date, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: CURRENT_DATE)
  - summary (text, NOT NULL)
  - need_assistance (boolean, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: false)
  - urgency_level (character varying, NULLABLE)
  - synced_to_ctrack (boolean, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: true)
  - document_urls (ARRAY, NULLABLE)
  - status (character varying, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: 'active'::character varying)
  - created_by (uuid, NOT NULL)
  - created_at (timestamp with time zone, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: now())
  - updated_at (timestamp with time zone, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: now())
**Foreign Keys:**
  * FK: created_by -> d3_employee(id)
  * FK: customer_id -> a1_company_list(company_list_id)
  * FK: sales_pic_id -> d3_employee(id)

### TABEL: a2_worksheet_checklists
**Columns:**
  - id (uuid, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: gen_random_uuid())
  - worksheet_id (bigint, NOT NULL)
  - check_label (text, NOT NULL)
  - is_verified (boolean, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: false)
  - verified_by (uuid, NULLABLE)
  - verified_at (timestamp with time zone, NULLABLE)
  - sort_order (smallint, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: 0)
  - created_at (timestamp with time zone, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: now())
**Foreign Keys:**
  * FK: verified_by -> d3_employee(id)
  * FK: worksheet_id -> a2_worksheets(worksheet_id)

### TABEL: a2_worksheet_documents
**Columns:**
  - id (uuid, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: gen_random_uuid())
  - worksheet_id (bigint, NOT NULL)
  - doc_name (text, NOT NULL)
  - doc_type (character varying, NOT NULL)
  - file_size_kb (integer, NULLABLE)
  - doc_url (text, NOT NULL)
  - doc_description (text, NULLABLE)
  - is_verified (boolean, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: false)
  - uploaded_by (uuid, NULLABLE)
  - uploaded_at (timestamp with time zone, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: now())
  - created_at (timestamp with time zone, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: now())
**Foreign Keys:**
  * FK: uploaded_by -> d3_employee(id)
  * FK: worksheet_id -> a2_worksheets(worksheet_id)

### TABEL: a2_worksheet_photos
**Columns:**
  - id (uuid, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: gen_random_uuid())
  - worksheet_id (bigint, NOT NULL)
  - photo_label (text, NOT NULL)
  - photo_status (text, NOT NULL)
  - photo_url (text, NULLABLE)
  - file_name (text, NULLABLE)
  - taken_at (timestamp with time zone, NULLABLE)
  - is_verified (boolean, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: false)
  - sort_order (smallint, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: 0)
  - created_at (timestamp with time zone, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: now())
**Foreign Keys:**
  * FK: worksheet_id -> a2_worksheets(worksheet_id)

### TABEL: a2_worksheet_physical_items
**Columns:**
  - id (uuid, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: gen_random_uuid())
  - worksheet_id (bigint, NOT NULL)
  - item_label (text, NOT NULL)
  - item_value (text, NOT NULL)
  - item_unit (text, NULLABLE)
  - sort_order (smallint, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: 0)
  - created_at (timestamp with time zone, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: now())
**Foreign Keys:**
  * FK: worksheet_id -> a2_worksheets(worksheet_id)

### TABEL: a2_worksheets
**Columns:**
  - worksheet_id (bigint, NOT NULL)
  - transaction_no (character varying, NOT NULL)
  - job_no (character varying, NOT NULL)
  - customer_id (uuid, NOT NULL)
  - created_by_user_id (bigint, NULLABLE)
  - create_date (date, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: CURRENT_DATE)
  - status_kendala (character varying, NULLABLE, DEFAULT: 'normal'::character varying)
  - field_agent_id (uuid, NULLABLE)
  - sales_pic_id (uuid, NULLABLE)
  - shipper (text, NULLABLE)
  - consignee (text, NULLABLE)
  - mawb (character varying, NULLABLE)
  - hawb (character varying, NULLABLE)
  - handover_datetime (timestamp with time zone, NULLABLE)
  - handover_location (text, NULLABLE)
  - pihak_penyerah (text, NULLABLE)
  - pihak_penerima (text, NULLABLE)
  - is_dangerous_goods (boolean, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: false)
  - special_handling (text, NULLABLE)
  - has_issue (boolean, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: false)
  - issue_note (text, NULLABLE)
  - is_exported_pdf (boolean, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: false)
  - updated_at (timestamp with time zone, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: now())
  - conversation_id (uuid, NULLABLE)
**Foreign Keys:**
  * FK: conversation_id -> a2_record_conversations(id)
  * FK: customer_id -> a1_company_list(company_list_id)
  * FK: field_agent_id -> d3_employee(id)
  * FK: sales_pic_id -> d3_employee(id)

### TABEL: d3_employee
**Columns:**
  - id (uuid, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: gen_random_uuid())
  - employee_id (character varying, NOT NULL)
  - full_name (character varying, NOT NULL)
  - email (character varying, NOT NULL)
  - phone (character varying, NULLABLE)
  - identity_type (character varying, NULLABLE, DEFAULT: 'KTP'::character varying)
  - identity_number (character varying, NULLABLE)
  - join_date (date, NOT NULL)
  - employment_status (character varying, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: 'PROBATION'::character varying)
  - position_id (uuid, NOT NULL)
  - department_id (uuid, NOT NULL)
  - work_location (character varying, NOT NULL, DEFAULT: 'HQ'::character varying)
  - avatar_url (text, NULLABLE)
  - created_at (timestamp with time zone, NULLABLE, DEFAULT: now())
  - updated_at (timestamp with time zone, NULLABLE, DEFAULT: now())
**Foreign Keys:**
  * FK: department_id -> d3_departments(id)
  * FK: position_id -> d3_positions(id)
  * FK: department_id -> d3_departments(id)
